messages.subject: Deducer Epical
parts:

messages.author: 1a09129d38549286
messages.subject: Re: Deducer Epical
parts:
Hi, Will

I suppose you mean "epicalc" (http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/
epicalc/)

You can add the functions of any package into Deducer. For that, you
have to create the dialogs for selecting data(*) and the functions to
run (and optionally check) the dialog. Deducer's wiki explains very
well how to do it:
http://www.deducer.org/pmwiki/index.php?n=Main.Development

(*) The widgets are specially prepared to select data from data
frames. You can also design dialogs for selecting other objects of the
workspace, although it's not that straightforward.

I do think that creating such dialogs is easy, although laborious as
well. But that's just my opinion.

Helios
